  children={"Stop a node following its catalog"}

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/unlink_node_template/{project_guid}/{workflow_guid}/{node_guid}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Takes local ownership of a linked node's files.

Nothing on disk changes - the node keeps every file it has, keeps running,
and keeps its provenance for display. All that stops is the following, so
its files become editable and it is no longer offered catalog updates.

Deliberately one-way. Re-linking would have to assume the files still
match the version they claim, which nothing here can check once they have
been editable; a node that wants to follow the catalog again is a node
built from the template afresh.
